title: add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples + docs site updates
author: Priya Patel
description:
Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling example integrations across the redwood-examples repo and docs site. Motivation: provide reproducible, opinionated examples for customers adopting RAG + tool-calling patterns with Redwood's streaming API and function/tool calls. This PR bundles: 1) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md: new quickstart with architecture diagrams, recommended model/quantization profiles, and example prompts; 2) redwood-examples/rag-agent/: Python and TypeScript example agents (playground scripts, docker-compose for local dev, minimal vectorstore stubs); 3) redwood-examples/tools/: two sample tool adapters (search and knowledge-base lookup) and a mock HTTP tool for integration tests; 4) docs site navigation and sidebar updates to surface the new quickstarts under "Quickstarts -> Agents & RAG". Checklist:
- [x] Quickstart content drafted and reviewed by PM/Docs
- [x] Example agents implemented: Python and TS minimal agents + tests
- [x] Tool adapter examples implemented and sandboxed
- [x] Docs site build passes locally and CI
- [x] Added short tutorial video link and runnable snippets
Testing notes: unit tests for example adapters (mocked vectorstore) and a docs smoke test were added. CI initially failed on docs lint due to a frontmatter typo; fixed in second commit. Backwards compatibility: examples are additive and do not change existing runtime interfaces. Linear/Jira: references ENG-4812 and SUP-2120 for follow-ups (enterprise quickstarts, additional vectorstore integrations).
